text: {"assertions":["On 2026-02-01, a stale state bug was fixed in ui/state/cacheSlice.ts where an old value persisted in the store snapshot.","The root cause of the stale state bug was two database writes that were never wrapped in a transaction.","The fix was implemented by wrapping both writes in a single transaction in PR #1579 on branch fix/stale-state-1.","The stale state bug could be reproduced by editing a record and then navigating back to the list view.","The bug only appeared after the client had already retried once, making it difficult to identify.","The ui/state/cacheSlice.test.ts file contains the test coverage for the cache slice functionality.","After applying the fix, memory usage stabilized at 442 MB instead of climbing past 6 GB.","The codebase uses TypeScript for web UI state management."]}
